newsitem.title: UK: UK to build 14 hospitals using private finance.
newsitem.headline: UK to build 14 hospitals using private finance.

text.p: UK Health Secretary Frank Dobson will announce later on Thursday the go-ahead for the construction of 14 hospitals under the private finance initiative (PFI), Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said.
He told a news conference that the announcement would show that the new Labour government's determination to reinvigorate the PFI was bearing early fruit.

The hospitals, which will be built in every region of Britain, will no longer be "castles in the air" because of Labour's success in cutting down the potential number of PFI projects in the health service and concentrating on the most promising, Brown said.
